open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions: Decisions — standing approval of agent-written room names
open_points.text: "each room it adds waits for the owner's approval of the exact request, its name included (R0-99), unless the owner gave a standing approval; the owner refuses a name that breaks the rule before it is written"
open_points.question: When a flow has standing approval and proposes a noncompliant room name, is the write allowed without review or must it stop so the owner can refuse that exact name?
options: Standing approval allows the write; the writer rule may be violated and the name reaches the agent
Every room name still receives per-request owner review, so standing approval does not bypass name approval
An automated check blocks noncompliant names despite the statement that Registry performs no content check
Standing approval for adding rooms is forbidden entirely
open_points.default_guess: Forbid standing approval for adding rooms so every exact name is reviewed.

witness.initial: An agent session has an active project, and the owner has given the flow version standing approval for its add-room node.
events: The agent submits an add-room request whose name identifies a person's disability.
Kernel executes the node under the standing approval without asking the owner about this exact request.
Registry performs no content check and would accept the name.
outcomes: The exception for standing approval allows the room to be written and its name to reach the agent.
The statement that the owner refuses every rule-breaking name before it is written requires the write to be stopped.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent see whether the room was created.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions: Decisions — room names already present in the migration source
open_points.text: "The owner learns the rule from the governance's rules for writers, read before the import (R0-79), where the names of imported projects are set"
open_points.question: What happens when a selected VPS project already contains a room name that breaks the rule, given that the import preserves rooms and rooms can neither be renamed nor removed?
options: The entire import is refused until the export is corrected outside Registry
The owner may replace room names as part of the import, as with project names and aliases
The project is excluded from the import
The room name is imported unchanged and may reach the agent
open_points.default_guess: Require the migration script to identify and correct noncompliant room names before producing the import file.

witness.initial: A selected VPS project contains a room named after an occupant's health condition.
events: The owner reads the writer rule before import.
The owner sets the imported project's display name and alias.
The import processes the project's existing rooms.
outcomes: The existing room name is preserved, imported and later exposed in the agent projection.
The import is refused or requires the room name to be replaced before acceptance.
witness.observer: The owner importing the project and the agent reading its room list.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions: Decisions — first-release installation of agent instructions
open_points.text: "adding the rule there is the platform's change, made before the first release goes into production"
open_points.question: Who verifies that the required AGENTS.md change is installed and effective, what observable evidence proves it, and what prevents production or agent writes if installation fails or the installed file is stale?
options: Code Factory admission verifies the exact installed instruction and blocks production on failure
Deployment performs and verifies the installation, aborting on failure
Kernel checks an instruction version before permitting Registry writes
The owner checks the file manually, with no technical release gate
Production proceeds even if the change is missing
open_points.default_guess: Make the installed instruction and its version a checked first-release admission prerequisite, with production blocked when absent or stale.

witness.initial: The first Registry release is ready, but VM Agent still has the earlier AGENTS.md.
events: The release is admitted without a stated check of the installed agent instructions.
The agent proposes a room name that the new rule forbids.
outcomes: Production was valid because the platform change was merely expected, and the agent may write under its old instructions.
Production must have been blocked because the instruction change is a prerequisite of the first release.
witness.observer: The owner deploying the release and later approving or discovering the room.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions: Decisions — owner reading the governance rule
open_points.text: "The owner learns the rule from the governance's rules for writers, read before the import"
open_points.question: What records or verifies that the owner read the applicable rule before import, and what happens if that prerequisite has not been completed?
options: Import is unavailable until the owner explicitly acknowledges the versioned writer rules
The import confirmation records an acknowledgement of the rules
Governance records the reading outside Registry and deployment relies on that record
Nothing verifies it; import proceeds regardless
open_points.default_guess: Require a versioned governance acknowledgement before import and block the import when it is absent.

witness.initial: The owner has not read the current writer rules but can reach the import interface.
events: The owner selects the VPS projects and supplies aliases.
outcomes: The import succeeds because Registry promises nothing about names written against the rule.
The import is refused because reading the rules is a prerequisite stated by the decision.
